description: This file is a shell script designed to monitor and manage various system processes and services on an Atom-based platform. It handles tasks such as ensuring essential services are running (e.g., WiFi, web server, Harvester, NTP), performing health checks, recycling interfaces on failure, and logging system status. The script includes mechanisms for restarting services, checking for zombie processes, and handling specific platform conditions like mesh configurations and device-specific adjustments.

methods.name: restart_wifi
methods.description: Restarts the WiFi services by stopping and starting related processes and interfaces.

methods.name: Zombie_check
methods.description: Checks for zombie processes and reports their count.
